definitions.explanation: The time of day when light first appears in the sky; the beginning of morning.
The start of a new era, period, or development.

examples.japanese: {夜明|よあ}けに{目|め}が{覚|さ}めた。
{夜明|よあ}け{前|まえ}が{一番|いちばん}{暗|くら}い。
examples.notes: A common saying meaning things are worst just before they get better

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{時代|じだい}の{夜明|よあ}けだ。
examples.english: It's the dawn of a new era.

notes:
USAGE: {夜明|よあ}け refers to the time when the sky begins to lighten. It can also be used figuratively to mean the beginning of something new.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{夜明|よあ}け{前|まえ} (before dawn)
・{夜明|よあ}けとともに (at dawn, with the break of day)
・〜の{夜明|よあ}け (the dawn of ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{明|あ}け{方|がた} - early morning, dawn
・{暁|あかつき} - dawn (literary)
・{日|ひ}の{出|で} - sunrise
